dimensions.note: No credential or secret handling. The terminal-keymap methods write per-user config bodies (pi keybindings, Ghostty config) and paths, neither of which is sensitive; no vault reference is needed and no secret is logged.

Each of the eight methods logs at info with structured placeholders and no interpolation. This release adds a completion log to terminalReport (byte count) and the probe log now carries the multiplexer. No secret or config-body values are logged.

Missing CLI binaries return null from run() and are recorded as unavailable rather than throwing. apply writes happen before writeResource, so an I/O failure throws and leaves no half-written data record. Missing /proc ancestry is surfaced as ancestryUnavailable. terminalReport tolerates absent records: it renders placeholders rather than throwing, so it can run in a partial/diagnosis sequence.

agent_config_test.ts now runs 33 tests. New in this release: detectMultiplexer precedence (herdr > tmux > none), two renderTerminalReport cases (full apply run and diagnosis/VTE fallback with warnings), and a terminalReport method test that seeds readResource records and asserts the markdown written through createFileWriter. Still not unit-tested: probeTerminalChain, readDefaultTerminal, readProcAncestry's live path, applyXdgDefaultTerminal, and verifyGhosttyConfig, which depend on the host and are exercised by the workflow / manual smoke runs.

All apply methods are idempotent: pi keybindings merge and skip the write when the desired mapping already holds; mergeGhosttyConfig strips every font-family and conflicting ctrl+enter line and re-appends a canonical pair; xdg-default writes only when content differs. terminalReport is a pure read-and-render; re-running overwrites the report file with the same content.
No external HTTP or network calls. Only local CLI probes (gsettings, xdg-terminal-exec, ghostty, command -v) and local filesystem reads/writes.

Subprocesses use Deno.Command(...).output(), which drains and closes pipes on every path. No temp files or open handles are created; file reads use readTextIfPresent and return null instead of leaking errors.
README examples and tests use generic names and OS temp dirs; no real hostnames, IPs, account identifiers, or personal paths are committed. Test fixtures use /a/b, /h, and C:\Lo placeholders.

Seven strict z.object resource schemas with no .passthrough(), so CEL validation against probe/plan attributes works. This release adds the required terminal-probe.multiplexer field so the workflow's planKeymap wiring resolves at runtime instead of failing zod validation.

Every resource and file spec sets lifetime and garbageCollection: transient snapshots use 7d, applied-state records use infinite, and the new terminalReport file uses 7d; all use garbageCollection 10.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model. It inventories agent config and reconciles terminal config; there is no create/update/delete/sync resource lifecycle.

The only mutating methods (apply*) are gated by the workflow's manual_approval step and default to diagnosis-only (apply=false); they require an explicit platform/GNOME check (xdg) or resolved path and create missing parent dirs rather than failing. terminalReport is read-only.

Data instance names stay unique: terminal-probe, xdg-default-terminal-current, keymap-plan, pi-keybindings, ghostty-config, xdg-default-terminal, ghostty-verify. The new terminal-report-current is a file (spec terminalReport), not a resource instance, so it cannot collide with report-current (spec report).

terminalReport reads the latest stored records through ctx.readResource(instance) for terminal-probe, keymap-plan, pi-keybindings, ghostty-config, xdg-default-terminal, and ghostty-verify; it uses no direct dataRepository access. The other methods remain stateless.

Version bumped to 2026.10.16.2 with a no-op upgrades entry (new method, new file spec, and a new terminal-probe field; globalArguments unchanged), on top of the no-op 2026.10.15.3 and 2026.10.16.1 entries.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — terminalProbe writes method, timestamp, term, termProgram, wslDistroName, tmuxActive, herdrPaneId, multiplexer, ancestry, ancestryUnavailable, plus every classification field. xdgDefaultTerminalCurrent, keymapPlan, piKeybindings, ghosttyConfig, xdgDefaultTerminal (both branches), and ghosttyVerify each populate every declared field. terminalReport writes the terminalReport file (no resource schema); it is rendered from the six readResource records. No placeholder resource writes.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: pass — verifyGhosttyConfig caps rawOutput at 20000 chars and rawOutputTruncated records whether it was capped. readProcAncestry's max-8 walk reports ancestryUnavailable when the chain cannot be read at all.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — one writer per resource instance name; xdg-default-terminal is written by two branches of applyXdgDefaultTerminal with identical shape; terminal-report-current is a distinct file instance from report-current.
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — all seven resource schemas have a producing code path for every field, including the newly added multiplexer and ancestryUnavailable, nullable probe misses, and the absent-ghostty verification branch.
